label: Hint items have no attack
summary: Food and medicine items that ASS turned into Hints are listed in the Hint category, the vanilla throwing weapons leave it, and Hint items carry no attack, shown or dealt.

edits.why: GetEquipProperties: 'cat==6 || cat==10' (food/medicine keep their raw attack) -> '(cat^2)&3==0' (also category 2 = THROW_1)
CalcAttack: the same category test widened to category 2 (attack 0 for THROW_1 items)

vanilla.reason: In vanilla category 2 is the Heaven Sword, Shakram and Runesword, which would lose their attack; this only makes sense with ASS's Hint items.
